g.text: Urban Sindh earners' average pay climbs with age to a peak at 55-59, then drops
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file merged with household file. Sample: Sindh urban earners aged 15-64 with annual earnings > 0 (n = 2,644).
Dots: individual earners (jittered +/-0.4 yr, alpha = 0.15); 2 outside the Rs 10,000-10,000,000 axis not shown.
Markers: weighted mean (hhweight) of each 5-year band, at its midpoint; hollow markers = thin bands (fewer than 30 unweighted observations).
